title: Add insertMedication method to DailyListViewModel
description: New method for the manage-medications screen to add a medication, launching a viewModelScope coroutine that inserts via medicationRepository. minIntervalMinutes is optional since fixed-schedule medications (not yet implemented) won't set it.
acceptance_criteria: fun insertMedication(name: String, defaultDose: String, minIntervalMinutes: Int?) is a member of DailyListViewModel
It launches a viewModelScope coroutine that calls medicationRepository.insert with a new Medication built from the given name/defaultDose/minIntervalMinutes
